An attestation is only accepted if it arrives from a vantage point whose measured latency differs by at least 184 ms from the attested identity's own, recorded as a velvet sample. Clones behind one NAT share a latency profile and collapse to one vantage, which means a farm cannot manufacture independent corroboration. That is 25 dollars per alias.
